objective: Harden release comparison for permission, host-access, content-script, network-rule, external-messaging, and extension-surface changes without predicting store behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect additions, removals, and required-versus-optional transitions for permissions and host access.
Compare content-script matches, exclusions, files, run timing, frames, execution world, and origin-fallback behavior deterministically.
Compare service-worker declarations, commands, DNR rule resources, externally connectable scopes, web-accessible resources, action, options, side-panel, and DevTools surfaces.
Classify findings with documented deterministic rules and require real manual-update validation only for explicitly defined critical changes.
Use representative fixtures and preserve the local-only privacy boundary.
Make no Chrome Web Store approval, security, compliance, or bug-absence claim.
stopConditions: The change requires browser automation, a live store account, network access, or non-public data.
A new runtime dependency appears necessary but is not explicitly approved.
The same failing approach has been attempted three times.
The exact Ox model is unavailable or rate-limited.
deliverable: Changed public files plus compact JSON listing covered diff categories, tests, known limitations, and blockers.
